name: GEdit-Bench
description: Genuine-edit image-editing benchmark from Step1X-Edit. 606 real-user editing cases across 11 categories, with paired English and Chinese instructions (1,212 rows). Used here as a held-out transfer target after LoRA training on synthesised edit pairs.
notes: Paper: arXiv:2504.17761. The English Full set is the usual scoring split. Headline scores on this suite use a VLM judge (VIEScore overall, 0-10).
